Storefront block for React & shadcn/ui

Storefront is a whole online shop for Halden, the home goods brand every commerce block uses, put together from the other blocks. The header search is Product Search, the bag is Cart, every grid and rail is Product Card, the collection page is Product Filters, the product page is Product Gallery, Variant Picker, Price, Reviews and the Delivery Estimate from Shipping Methods, checkout is Checkout, and the last two pages are Order Confirmation and Order Tracking. Storefront adds only the glue: a header and footer, routing, one shared store and small page layouts.
